en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Abu Ubeyda, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Do not let the embrace of the two arms with the blood cause you to wonder, for it, in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, is a killer who does not die’.
